m1688-summary-source.text: useful reviews kept producing more reviews without an effective stop or ruling, and we eventually did the work manually outside Morphisms.

meta.speaker: user
meta.primary_source: M1688 postmortem, unavailable at capture time
meta.note: Verbatim wording of the user's synthetic summary of M1688. It is a summary, not the primary postmortem; claims extracted from it are unverified against the primary record.

m1688-incident.text: Incident M1688: a review cascade that ended with work done manually outside Morphisms (known only via a synthetic secondary summary; primary postmortem unavailable).

review-cascade-failure-mode.text: Candidate failure mode: reviews that are individually useful can recursively generate further reviews with no effective stop condition and no ruling authority, so the attempt never terminates inside Morphisms and the work is eventually completed manually outside it.

meta.actor_scope: unresolved: the summary does not say which role produced the reviews or who could have ruled
meta.note: Extracted from a secondary summary; unverified against the M1688 primary postmortem. Not affirmed by the user as an established finding.

stop-threshold-handoff-proposal.text: A stop threshold on review-generated review might address the missing stop by bounding cascade length and forcing end-attempt, and a steward handoff after the stop might address the missing ruling by having the steward choose subsequent work. Together they might address the M1688 failure mode; neither a threshold value nor stopping authority has been chosen.

meta.policy_standing: not a policy; proposal for discussion only

objective-substitution-failure-mode.text: Candidate failure mode: a proposed mechanism (here, a notification mechanism) becomes the objective in place of the concern it was meant to serve (high CPU), so agents plan and pursue the mechanism carefully while the concern itself is not re-examined against alternatives.

meta.note: Drawn at the user's request while relating M1689 to the model; the wording is the assistant's, so it stays proposed until the user affirms it. It does not change the status of chosen-mechanism.
